summary: Today presents a mixed legal and market landscape driven by major High Court rulings alongside aggressive growth plans in satellite telecom and retail distribution. Key developments feature the Bombay High Court quashing prosecution sanctions against Chanda Kochhar, alongside ambitious network expansions announced by Reliance and home care brand Beco.

bullets.text: The Bombay High Court set aside the prosecution sanction against former ICICI Bank CEO Chanda Kochhar in the ICICI-Videocon bank loan case.
Delhi High Court issued notices seeking responses from the Ministry of Home Affairs on a PIL regarding police intimidation of practicing lawyers.
Reliance plans to build a 1,600-satellite network in India to offer domestic satellite internet coverage directly competing with Starlink.
Sustainable home care brand Beco plans expansion into over 25,000 general trade stores across India over the next two to three years.
Samsung regained the top market spot with a 17.7% market share following a 7.9% shipment increase, while iPhone shipments dropped 25%.
